title: Houthis Claim Strike on Another Saudi Oil Tanker
summary_full: With their ally, Iran, bottling up the Strait of Hormuz, the Houthi group in Yemen is escalating its declared blockade of Saudi shipping in another vital waterway, the Red Sea.
